target_rank_diagnostic.note: In the pre-guard all-file scoring run, all six primary targets ranked within the top 9 of 1096 files in both repeats; the fs sandbox target had low absolute calibration (0.46-0.47) but rank 8-9.
target_rank_diagnostic.interpretation: System One file-path ranking was strong; the remaining miss was absolute calibration, not reachability.

architecture_conclusion: Semantic directory pruning is rejected because descendant relevance is not monotonic in parent-directory metadata.
File Discovery V1 mechanically enumerates supported files and independently Noul-scores each file once.
A high-confidence absolute threshold is augmented by a small relative recall guard instead of lowering the global threshold.
No top-k, source reads, global model Stop, or repeated unchanged-state scoring is used.
Future work in this domain is efficiency/generalization/calibration, not a new traversal architecture.
